简单工厂在一个入口中选择产品；工厂方法由创建者的子类覆写创建步骤。: Simple Factory selects a product at one entry point; Factory Method lets Creator subclasses override the creation step.
浅色按钮 + 浅色菜单；客户端流程不变: Light button + light menu; client workflow unchanged
单例控制一种对象的实例数；享元按内在状态复用多种对象，并保留独立外部状态。: Singleton limits instances of one type; Flyweight shares intrinsic state across objects while keeping extrinsic state separate.
组合通常聚合多个子项，表达树；装饰器通常包裹单个组件，逐层增强行为。: Composite usually groups multiple children into a tree; Decorator usually wraps one component to add behavior layer by layer.
紧急通知跨过发送接口，切换短信或邮件实现: Urgent notification uses the sending interface to switch between SMS and email implementations
两个变化维度全部用继承组合，子类数量会按组合数量增长。: If both dimensions are combined through inheritance, the number of subclasses grows with their combinations.
本例省去样式副本: Style copies avoided in this example
共享样式不包含位置；同一份内在状态可以在不同位置绘制。: The shared style contains no position; the same intrinsic state can be drawn at different positions.
享元允许按键存在多份共享实例；单例约束指定作用域中的单一实例。: Flyweight allows one shared instance per key; Singleton limits a given scope to one instance.
共享不可变的内在状态，把每次使用的外部状态单独传入。: Share immutable intrinsic state and pass extrinsic state separately for each use.
字符 A 和字体是可共享的内在状态；每次出现的位置是独立的外部状态。: Character A and its font are shared intrinsic state; each occurrence's position is separate extrinsic state.
三个字符位置引用同一份内在样式: Three character positions share the same intrinsic style.
保护代理、虚拟代理和远程代理；代理与真实对象遵守同一调用契约。: Protection proxies, virtual proxies, and remote proxies all share the same calling contract as the real object.
通过保持目标接口的替身控制对真实对象的访问。: Control access to the real object through a stand-in that preserves its interface.
桌面是尚未加入成品的原料；Builder 此时为空。调用方决定按配方加入哪几层。: The ingredients on the work surface have not yet been added to the product; the Builder is empty. The caller chooses which layers to add.
实体层代表已加入的产品部分，不是 Python 的内存布局；链式调用本身不等于建: The solid layers represent added product parts, not Python memory layout; method chaining alone does not make a Builder.
这里采用首个能处理者终止的链；某些责任链会让多个节点继续处理。额度是教学参数。: Here the first capable handler ends the chain; some Chain of Responsibility implementations let multiple handlers continue. Approval limits are example values.
责任链寻找处理者，节点可终止传递；装饰器层层叠加职责并委托被包装对象。: Chain of Responsibility finds a handler, which may stop forwarding; Decorator layers behavior and delegates to the wrapped object.
功能可以多种组合且要按对象动态添加，继承难覆盖所有组合。: Features can be combined in many ways and added to individual objects at runtime; inheritance cannot easily cover every combination.
额度不足；当前节点把同一请求交给下一节点。: The handler's approval limit is too low, so it forwards the same request to the next handler.
额度足够，总监完成审批，后续节点不再处理。: The Director's approval limit covers the amount; they approve the request and stop the chain.
按钮与业务操作绑在一起，就难以统一排队、记录或撤销。: When buttons are coupled to business operations, it is hard to queue, log, or undo them consistently.
组合表达树形整体与部分；解释器常借助组合树，但额外定义语法规则和求值语义。: Composite models tree-shaped part–whole structures; Interpreter often uses a Composite tree but also defines grammar rules and evaluation semantics.
组合灵活，但调用层次增加；包装顺序可能改变结果和调试路径。: Composition is flexible, but adds call layers; wrapping order may change the result and debugging path.
外层费用包装器调用内层，再逐层返回加价结果: The outer cost wrapper calls the inner one; each layer adds its surcharge as the result returns.
Add 先得到左值 2，再递归解释 Multiply；后者得到 3 × 4 =: Add gets the left operand, 2, then recursively evaluates Multiply, which returns 3 × 4 = 12.
分层是展开的调用嵌套示意；本例加价可交换，但其他装饰操作未必可以交换顺序。: The layers show nested calls; these additive surcharges can be applied in either order, but other decorator operations may be order-sensitive.
中介者封装多方的协作规则；观察者传播一个主题的变化，通常不负责整体协调。: Mediator encapsulates coordination rules among participants; Observer broadcasts changes in a subject and usually does not coordinate the whole group.
表单联动、对话框控件、参与者之间有明确的集中协调规则。: Linked form controls, dialog controls, or participants with clear centralized coordination rules.
备忘录保存“当时是什么”；命令保存“要做什么”。命令的撤销也可以借助备忘录。: Memento stores what the state was; Command stores what to do. A Command can also use a Memento to implement undo.
以不可变字符串快照示意封装；Python 下划线是访问约定。可变嵌套状态要额外处: An immutable string snapshot illustrates encapsulation; Python underscores are an access convention. Mutable nested state needs explicit copying.
主题变化时，通知当前注册的多个观察者。: When the subject changes, notify its currently registered observers.
新增通知渠道不应迫使主题依赖每一种具体接收者。: Adding a notification channel should not make the subject depend on each concrete recipient.
观察者强调一对多变化通知；中介者集中封装多个参与者之间的协作规则。: Observer emphasizes one-to-many change notifications; Mediator centralizes coordination rules among participants.
文章发布触发当前订阅者: Publishing an article notifies current subscribers
主题保存观察者引用；观察者可以注册，也可以主动取消。: The subject holds observer references; observers can subscribe and unsubscribe.
邮件与短信收到事件，App 不再收到；无需修改主题的发布逻辑。: The email and SMS subscribers receive the event; the App subscriber no longer does. The subject's publishing logic stays unchanged.
上下文持有当前状态: The context holds the current state
把与状态有关的行为交给状态对象，让同一请求产生不同反应。: Delegate state-dependent behavior to state objects so the same request can produce different responses.
对象每个方法都在重复检查 status，合法转换规则散落在条件分支里。: Every method repeatedly checks status, and valid transition rules are scattered across conditionals.
增加状态类；必须明确谁负责转换，避免上下文和状态对象互相争夺规则。: Adds state classes; define who owns transitions so the context and state objects do not compete for the rules.
状态描述对象当前所处阶段，事件可推动内部转换；策略通常由外部选择可替换算法。: State models an object's current phase; events can trigger internal transitions. Strategy usually selects a replaceable algorithm externally.
仅演示三种状态和两个事件；转换规则是示例业务，并非状态模式要求的固定流程。: Only three states and two events are shown; the transition rules belong to this example, not to the State pattern itself.
稿件由当前状态决定能否审核: The draft's current state determines whether it can be approved.
步骤组合经常在运行时改变时，组合或策略通常更灵活。: When the combination of steps changes often at runtime, composition or Strategy is usually more flexible.
模板方法把变化点留在继承层次；策略把算法作为对象或函数注入上下文。: Template Method keeps variation in the inheritance hierarchy; Strategy injects an algorithm as an object or function into the context.
读取一段 JSON 文本，还没有解析成记录。: Read JSON text before parsing it into records.
当前 Draft 不接受审核通过事件；状态保持 Draft。: The Draft state rejects approval; the state remains Draft.
随后执行 submit 才进入审核态。相同请求的效果取决于当前状态。: Only submit moves the draft into Review; the same request has different effects depending on the current state.
把对一组元素类型的操作放进访问者，通过 accept 分派到对应操作。: Put operations over a set of element types in Visitor objects; each element's accept method dispatches to the matching operation.
访问者需要元素暴露足够信息；增加操作容易，增加元素类型较难。: A Visitor needs elements to expose enough information; adding operations is easy, but adding element types is harder.
Python 用显式 visit_book / visit_food 表达两次分: Python uses explicit visit_book / visit_food methods to model double dispatch, not language-level function overloading. Tax rates are example values.
价格为教学参数；展示函数作为策略，算法选择与页面中的“状态模式”业务转换不同。: Prices are example values; this shows functions used as strategies. Choosing an algorithm differs from the business state transitions shown in the State pattern.
